**Quaternion Octonion Reformulation of Grand Unified Theories**

*Pushpa(1), P. S. Bisht (1,2), Tianjun Li (2) and O. P. S. Negi (1.2)*

14 pp, 3 sections.

**Abstract.** In this paper, Grand Uniﬁed theories are discussed in terms o f quater- nions and octonions by using the relation between quaternio n basis el- ements with Pauli matrices and Octonions with Gell Mann λ matri- ces. Connection between the unitary groups of GUTs and the no rmed division algebra has been established to re-describe the SU (5) gauge group. We have thus described the SU (5) gauge group and its subgroup SU (3)C × SU (2)L × U (1) by using quaternion and octonion basis ele- ments. As such the connection between U (1) gauge group and complex number, SU (2) gauge group and quaternions and SU (3) and octonions is established.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2 SU(5) Gauge Symmetry; 4 Discussion and Conclusion
